author: potuz
content:
By the way there are two arguments I've heard in ACDT that I just plain wrong:

1. There's tech debt in not implementing this now: False, the RLP check is on gossip, it can be removed and does not need to be maintained. The signature is also irrelevant. The whole payload structure changing, that's also irrelevant as it's anyway changing in H*. 

2. It would be more work to add it in H: False, we already have implemented RLP, all of us except Grandine, it is the exact amount of work if we do it now or in H.

author: nflaig

author: raxhvl
content:
The signature adds a capital requirement with no penalty: a squatter can buy in a spot in the queue at price the of a signature, block out valid envelope, and withdraw to walk out without a consequence?

Its a friction, sure, but does not meaningfully improve security. 

Wouldn't you much rather solve queue management using fifo and puting a time cap on how long a payload can squat a queue spot?

author: potuz
content: No, I would rather check the signature to prevent a random kid from peering for free and on top of that cap it as we do

author: potuz
content: Fifo with signature check is strictly better than fifo without one. No matter how marginal the gain is

author: raxhvl
content: strictly better is ignoring the cost side of the equation, signing and verifying isnt free and that cost impacts every envelope

author: potuz
content: that's the whole point of P2P DOS though, we want it for the sender to be harder to prepare something than the cost of the check. If the sender needs to sign it spends something and we verify the signature faster. On the other system we need to compute the HTR at zero cost to the sender

author: potuz
content: I get it though that to verify an invalid signature anyway we need to do the HTR

author: tbenr
content: ? you need to make sure that the fields you get in the envelop are correct, not that the block hash is what you expect

author: raxhvl
content: and we need to do it exactly how EL does it, if we make a mistake we risk rejecting a valid envelop  - there was an [empty tx edge case that was caught](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5770#discussion_r4398966120) that could have caused it.
